what_it_is: A mask-aware sequential decision formulation in which a scan order is built one legal track at a time.
what_it_is_not: It is not evidence that online reinforcement learning was trained with Abaqus in the loop.
manuscript_safe_wording: We formulate scan-order optimization as a finite-horizon sequential decision problem with legal-action masking.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: Online Abaqus RL solved scan-order control.

what_it_is: A trainable PyTorch line-graph message-passing reward regressor trained offline on combined108 teacher-labelled data.
what_it_is_not: It is not a deployed GNN pointer policy and not an actor-critic controller.
manuscript_safe_wording: Run26 included an offline GNN reward-regression diagnostic over adjacent-track graph features.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: A GNN-pointer RL policy was trained and deployed as the final optimizer.

what_it_is: A separate MLP action scorer with pointer-style masked decoding trained by reward-weighted behavior cloning on observed teacher sequences.
what_it_is_not: It is not PPO, not actor-critic, not online RL, and not the same module as the GNN reward regressor.
manuscript_safe_wording: The pointer-style scorer was trained offline by reward-weighted behavior cloning and used as a policy-learning diagnostic.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: PPO-trained graph pointer controller; online learned policy.

what_it_is: A deterministic proxy generator that produced graph-pointer-inspired candidate orders before teacher validation.
what_it_is_not: It is not a trained RL policy and not teacher validation by itself.
manuscript_safe_wording: Run06 provided deterministic graph-pointer proxy candidates for early probing.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: Run06 trained a graph-pointer RL model.

what_it_is: A later graph/order model diagnostic used in model-update runs where available in the run artifacts.
what_it_is_not: It is not the sole final optimizer and not evidence of GNN/RL superiority.
manuscript_safe_wording: Later graph/order models are reported as auxiliary diagnostics within the offline model-update loop.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: The final result was produced by a deployed OrderGraphMLP controller.

what_it_is: A pointer-like transition-frequency/order diagnostic used to characterize learned or empirical transition preferences where present in later update artifacts.
what_it_is_not: It is not an online RL policy and not final controller evidence.
manuscript_safe_wording: Transition-frequency and pointer-style diagnostics are auxiliary evidence about sequence structure.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: A transition-frequency diagnostic is a deployed RL controller.

what_it_is: The main offline optimization loop that updated surrogate diagnostics, selected novel/diverse/uncertain candidates, and then used teacher validation for chosen batches.
what_it_is_not: It is not online RL and not new candidate generation in this clarification package.
manuscript_safe_wording: The implemented loop is teacher-guided and offline, combining surrogate-guided active learning, novelty/diversity selection, policy-learning diagnostics, and teacher validation.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: The final batches came from a single online RL controller.

what_it_is: The expensive teacher stage that evaluates selected scan orders and provides labels for the evidence dataset.
what_it_is_not: It does not train an online controller and does not prove global optimality.
manuscript_safe_wording: Abaqus teacher simulations validate selected scan orders and supply labels for offline model updates.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: Abaqus was used as an online RL environment.

what_it_is: Legacy PPO code for a different/default scan-planning environment under rl/ and older asset outputs.
what_it_is_not: It is not the Stage 3 deposition-track GNN pointer implementation and should not be cited as the current paper's main algorithm.
manuscript_safe_wording: PPO is excluded from the current Stage 3 claim and reserved for future work.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: PPO-based scan-order optimization is the main method in this paper.

what_it_is: The frozen paper-facing evidence package based on native combined552 teacher-labelled data and final claim boundaries.
what_it_is_not: It does not support claiming a single deployed GNN-encoded graph-pointer RL policy as the main final optimizer.
manuscript_safe_wording: The final evidence supports bounded variable-N scan-order optimization within tested N values and strategy space, with GNN/pointer diagnostics auxiliary.
unsafe_wording_to_avoid: GNN-RL outperformed all baselines; arbitrary-N solved; online RL solved Abaqus control.
